question: Who acts as the link between the Governor and the State Council of Ministers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chief Minister**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Chief Minister** serves as the principal channel of communication between the **Governor** and the **State Council of Ministers**, ensuring the smooth functioning of the **State Executive**.
 
• Under **Article 167** of the **Constitution of India**, it is the fundamental duty of the **Chief Minister** to communicate all decisions taken by the **Council of Ministers** regarding the administration of the **State** and proposals for legislation to the **Governor**.
 
• The **Chief Minister** is required to furnish any information related to the administration of the **State** affairs or legislative proposals that the **Governor** may request for review.
 
• If the **Governor** directs, the **Chief Minister** must submit for the consideration of the **Council of Ministers** any matter on which a decision has been made by an individual **Minister** but has not yet been collectively deliberated upon by the **Council**.
